purpose: Field-level triangulation of comparator and national implementation context.
target: TA1121 acoramidis ATTR-CM implementation in England
independence_rule: NICE and NHS England are distinct official publishers; ICB records are an independent local custodian. Mirrors and training reproductions do not count as independent corroboration.

fields.value: NHS hospital trusts through specialist amyloidosis services
national TA1121 publication followed by local 2026 implementation records

limitations: Comparator adoption does not prove displacement.
National resource-impact estimates cannot be mapped to local parameter d without an attributable decision record.
Public sources do not provide the approved Atlas n/m/d/mu/phi packet or joint uncertainty.
recommendation: Use the agreed fields for labelled public-context and synthetic sensitivity analysis only; keep empirical, payer, HTA, policy, regulatory, and calibrated claims disabled.
refresh_rule: Re-run field reconciliation when any source hash, revision, programme context, or intended use changes.
